title: Behavior, mechanisms, and applications of low-concentration CO2 in energy media
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,2762-2831
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00574K, Review Article
Minghai Shen, Wei Guo, Lige Tong, Li Wang, Paul K. Chu, Sibudjing Kawi, Yulong Ding
This review discusses the behavior of low-concentration carbon dioxide (LCC) in multiphase flows and interfaces, covering diffusion, adsorption, catalytic mechanisms, and applications in CO2 capture, storage, and conversion, challenges, and prospect.
